name: Da Terra
address: Town Hall Hotel, 8 Patriot Square, Bethnal Green, London, E2 9NF

menus.name: Three-course set lunch
menus.note: Thursday to Saturday; extra courses £35 (trout) and £20 (cheese)

alsoTry.name: Elis
alsoTry.note: Brazilian restaurant on the Town Hall Hotel's first floor, linked from Da Terra's website

hotel: the Town Hall Hotel in Bethnal Green
bookingOpens: Online only, through the booking page on Da Terra's website (OpenTable); no phone bookings. Tables open 60 days ahead.
cancellation: Card details are needed to book. Tables of up to six can cancel free up to 48 hours ahead by emailing booking@daterra.co.uk; later cancellations, no-shows and smaller numbers on the night may be charged a cancellation fee per guest.
groups: The largest table seats six. Na Mesa, the private dining room, seats up to 10 (namesa@daterra.co.uk).
dressCode: No dress code: the restaurant asks only that guests dress comfortably.
children: Not recommended for children under 8. No children's menu, prams or highchairs.
duration: About three hours for the tasting menu and two hours for the set lunch.
byob: Corkage £70 a 75cl bottle and £40 a 37.5cl bottle.
